The gross claims development triangle for Syndicate 510 shows stabilized older years (effectively no gross PYD); therefore gross PYD is reported as 0.0. Net PYD (surplus) of GBP 21.9m is recorded in the text but is NET of reinsurance. Users should note that the primary prior-year movement sentence in the report quotes a NET figure; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided.
